sections.label: What made it hard
sections.html:
• Two sources of truthAn order lives in Actifai and in the provider’s billing system, and the two have to agree. The provider calls back with each order’s status, which is how we catch a mismatch.
  • Plan mappingSingle, double, and triple play orders (internet, TV, and phone, alone or bundled) have to map onto each provider’s billing products.
  • Go-live coordinationEach launch lines up the provider and its integration partners, and I gather the requirements with them. A runbook covers each new provider’s setup, plan mapping, and go-live checklist.

sections.label: When an order fails
sections.html:
A failed submission goes into an exceptions queue in Actifai’s manager portal, where staff fix and resend it.

A correlation ID on every submission ties logs, Datadog monitors, and the queue to one order, with personal data redacted first.
